description:
Unit: U5
Plan: docs/plans/2026-11-04-1314-refactor-jido-test-tree-plan.md#u5-reorganize-system-load-benchmark-live-and-deferred-lanes

Outcome
System, load, benchmark, live, and deferred assets use their primary Jido.* owner paths, and all catalogs and CI commands use those paths.

Requirements and decisions
R2, R4, R5, R8-R13; KTD1-KTD3, KTD6-KTD8.

Affected surfaces
test/system/**; test/load/**; test/bench/**; test/live/**; test/quality/deferred/**; benchmark and load catalogs; .github/workflows/ci.yml; mix.exs; quality maps; source-manifest targets; and lane READMEs.

Implementation direction
Move runtime system and load files below jido/agent_server or jido/exec. Split benchmark action_flow assets among Flow compile, Exec runtime, and AI ReAct owners. Move Signal and AI benchmark and live assets under explicit jido paths. Move deferred Action/Flow and Signal probes below test/quality/deferred/jido without changing expected failures or dispositions. Update catalogs, scheduled commands, aliases, evidence paths, and current lane documentation atomically.

Acceptance
System, load, and benchmark smoke aliases run all registered families. Extended CI commands resolve every runner. Live and service tests stay opt-in. Deferred probes stay excluded with the same reasons. Catalog validation finds each evidence file and no duplicate family ID.

Verification
mix test.system --warnings-as-errors
mix test.load --warnings-as-errors
mix test.bench --warnings-as-errors
mix test test/quality/ci_workflow_test.exs --seed 0
mix quality.contract
mix format --check-formatted

Completion signal
All registered operational families resolve final paths, selection policy is unchanged, and U6 can start.
title: U5 Reorganize operational test lanes
